## Mutational signatures

```{r signatures_pdf_setup}
#| echo: false
#| eval: true

msig_pdf <- pcg_report$content$mutational_signatures
msig_conf_pdf <- pcg_report$settings$conf$somatic_snv$mutational_signatures
no_refit_pdf <- isFALSE(msig_pdf$eval) || isTRUE(msig_pdf$missing_data)
n_sbs_pdf <- NROW(msig_pdf$variant_set$all)
all_refsigs_pdf <- isTRUE(as.logical(msig_conf_pdf$all_reference_signatures))
no_site_prev_pdf <- isTRUE(as.logical(msig_pdf$result$no_site_prevalence))
fit_pdf <- msig_pdf$result$goodness_of_fit
poor_fit_pdf <- !no_refit_pdf && is.list(fit_pdf) &&
  isTRUE(fit_pdf$estimate < 0.9)
contributions_pdf <- msig_pdf$result$contributions

signatures_caption_pdf <- paste0(
  "Relative contribution of the top reference signatures (COSMIC) to the ",
  "mutational profile of ", pcg_report$settings$sample_id, ", with bootstrap ",
  "confidence intervals.")
aetiology_caption_pdf <- paste0(
  "Relative contribution of signatures per proposed aetiology.")
profile_caption_pdf <- paste0(
  "Raw mutational spectrum of single base substitutions (SBS) in their ",
  "trinucleotide context - not considering signature refitting.")
indel_caption_pdf <- paste0(
  "Raw mutational spectrum of insertions/deletions (ID) by context.")
```

The **MutationalPatterns** package [@Blokzijl2018-nc] is used to estimate the relative contribution of [known mutational signatures](https://cancer.sanger.ac.uk/signatures/) [@Alexandrov2020-gj] in **`r pcg_report$settings$sample_id`**: the optimal linear combination of reference signatures that most closely reconstructs the spectrum of single base substitutions (SBS) in the tumor is determined (*signature refitting*), and a bootstrapping approach is used to estimate the uncertainty of the signature contributions.

```{r signatures_pdf_missing}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr no_refit_pdf
cat(pcgrr:::pdf_note(paste0(
  "There are too few variants (**N = ", n_sbs_pdf, "**) in the tumor sample ",
  "for reliable refitting of mutational signatures."),
  title = "Limited variant data - refitting analysis omitted",
  kind = "warning"))
```

```{r signatures_pdf_reference}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr isFALSE(no_refit_pdf)

n_ref <- msig_pdf$result$n_reference_signatures
if (all_refsigs_pdf) {
  cat("All reference signatures (**n = ", n_ref, "**) were considered for ",
      "refitting (default - use `--tumor_type_reference_signatures` to ",
      "restrict refitting to signatures attributed to the tumor type). ",
      sep = "")
} else if (no_site_prev_pdf) {
  cat("The primary site of the sample (**",
      pcg_report$settings$conf$sample_properties$site, "**) is not yet ",
      "attributed with specific reference signatures - all reference ",
      "signatures (**n = ", n_ref, "**) were considered for refitting. ",
      sep = "")
} else {
  ref <- msig_pdf$result$reference_data
  ids <- if ("SIGNATURE_ID" %in% colnames(ref))
    unique(ref$SIGNATURE_ID) else character()
  cat("Reference signatures previously attributed to **",
      pcg_report$settings$conf$sample_properties$site, "** cancers were ",
      "considered for refitting (**n = ", length(ids), "**: ",
      paste(ids, collapse = ", "), "). ", sep = "")
}
cat("A total of **n = ", format(n_sbs_pdf, big.mark = ","), "** SNVs were ",
    "used for the mutational signature analysis of this tumor.\n\n", sep = "")
```

```{r signatures_pdf_poor_fit}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr poor_fit_pdf
cat(pcgrr:::pdf_note(
  if (all_refsigs_pdf) paste0(
    "Reconstruction of the mutational profile with the full set of COSMIC ",
    "reference signatures resulted in a sub-optimal fit (cosine similarity ",
    "< 0.9). This may reflect a low/noisy mutation count, sequencing ",
    "artefacts, or mutational processes not well represented among the ",
    "reference signatures - interpret the signature contributions with caution.")
  else paste0(
    "Reconstruction of the mutational profile with the selected COSMIC ",
    "reference signatures resulted in a sub-optimal fit (cosine similarity ",
    "< 0.9). A re-run with all reference signatures is warranted (i.e. ",
    "without the `--tumor_type_reference_signatures` option)."),
  title = "Suboptimal fit of mutational profile", kind = "warning"))
```

```{r signatures_pdf_kpis}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr isFALSE(no_refit_pdf)

col_high <- pcgrr::color_palette$oncogenicity$values[1]
cat(pcgrr:::pdf_kpi_row(list(
  list(title = "Dominant aetiologies",
       value = paste(utils::head(contributions_pdf$per_group$group, 2),
                     collapse = " · ")),
  list(title = "Goodness of signature fit",
       value = paste0(round(fit_pdf$estimate * 100, 1), "%"),
       color = if (poor_fit_pdf) col_high else NULL),
  list(title = "SNVs analyzed", value = format(n_sbs_pdf, big.mark = ",")))))
```

```{r signatures_pdf_contribution_plot}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr isFALSE(no_refit_pdf)
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 2.9
#| fig-cap: !expr signatures_caption_pdf

pcgrr::plot_signature_contributions(
  signature_contributions = contributions_pdf)[["ggplot"]] |>
  pcgrr:::pdf_plot_theme(base_size = 8) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(family = "sans", size = 8),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    legend.key.size = grid::unit(0.32, "cm")) +
  ggplot2::guides(fill = ggplot2::guide_legend(nrow = 2))
```

```{r signatures_pdf_aetiology_plot}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr isFALSE(no_refit_pdf) && NROW(contributions_pdf$per_group) > 0
#| fig-width: 3.4
#| fig-height: 1.8
#| out-width: 49%
#| fig-cap: !expr aetiology_caption_pdf

pg <- contributions_pdf$per_group
pcgrr:::pdf_plot_donut(
  data.frame(group = pg$group, N = pg$prop_group,
             Pct = pg$prop_group / sum(pg$prop_group) * 100),
  category = "group", title = NULL, center_label = "",
  show_counts = FALSE)
```

```{r signatures_pdf_table_heading}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr isFALSE(no_refit_pdf) && NROW(contributions_pdf$per_signature) > 0
cat("### Signature contributions\n\n")
```

```{r signatures_pdf_table}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr isFALSE(no_refit_pdf) && NROW(contributions_pdf$per_signature) > 0
pcgrr:::pdf_table_signatures(
  contributions_pdf$per_signature, color = report_color)
```

### Raw mutational spectrum

As a background perspective, the raw mutational spectrum of the sample is shown below, i.e. not considering the signature refitting analysis.

```{r signatures_pdf_profile}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr isFALSE(is.null(msig_pdf$result$mut_mat))
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 2.6
#| fig-cap: !expr profile_caption_pdf

catalogue_mat <- msig_pdf$result$mut_mat
y_max <- ceiling(max(catalogue_mat[, 1] / sum(catalogue_mat[, 1])) / 0.05) * 0.05
MutationalPatterns::plot_96_profile(
  catalogue_mat,
  colors = utils::head(pcgrr::color_palette$multi$values, 6),
  ymax = y_max) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    text = ggplot2::element_text(family = "sans", size = 7),
    ## 96 trinucleotide contexts are not legible at page width
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 6),
    strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 7))
```

```{r signatures_pdf_profile_missing}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr is.null(msig_pdf$result$mut_mat)
cat(pcgrr:::pdf_note(kind = "empty", 
  "No SNVs/single base substitutions were found in this sample.",
  title = "No SNVs"))
```

```{r signatures_pdf_indels}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr isFALSE(is.null(msig_pdf$result$indel_counts))
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 2.6
#| fig-cap: !expr indel_caption_pdf

MutationalPatterns::plot_indel_contexts(
  counts = msig_pdf$result$indel_counts, condensed = TRUE) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    text = ggplot2::element_text(family = "sans", size = 7),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 5),
    strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 6))
```

### Signature similarity

```{r signatures_pdf_similarity}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: true

sim_pdf <- msig_pdf$result$signature_similarity
if (is.null(sim_pdf) || NROW(sim_pdf) == 0) {
  cat(pcgrr:::pdf_note(paste0(
    "There are too few somatic variants (**N = ", n_sbs_pdf, "**) in the ",
    "tumor sample for a similarity analysis of mutational signatures (a ",
    "minimum of 30 SNVs is required)."),
    title = "Limited variant data - similarity analysis omitted",
    kind = "warning"))
} else {
  cat("The raw mutational spectrum of the sample (frequencies of ",
      "trinucleotide contexts) is compared to each of the reference ",
      "signatures (SBS) in COSMIC [@Alexandrov2020-gj]. The cosine similarity ranges from 0 to ",
      "1 (perfect match); the ten most similar signatures are shown",
      if (!all_refsigs_pdf && !no_site_prev_pdf) paste0(
        ", with signatures attributed to ",
        pcg_report$settings$conf$sample_properties$site,
        " cancers highlighted"),
      ".\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

```{r signatures_pdf_similarity_table}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr NROW(msig_pdf$result$signature_similarity) > 0
pcgrr:::pdf_table_signature_similarity(
  msig_pdf$result$signature_similarity, n = 10, color = report_color)
```
